Function Snapshot() As String
Dim p As PivotTable,f As PivotField,cell As Range
Set p=Worksheets(1).PivotTables("Made")
Snapshot="r1:" & p.TableRange1.Address & "|r2:" & p.TableRange2.Address
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|db:"
If p.DataBodyRange Is Nothing Then
Snapshot=Snapshot & "Nothing"
Else
Snapshot=Snapshot & p.DataBodyRange.Address
End If
Snapshot=Snapshot & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Err.Clear
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|rows:"
Snapshot=Snapshot & p.RowRange.Address
Snapshot=Snapshot & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Err.Clear
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|cols:"
Snapshot=Snapshot & p.ColumnRange.Address
Snapshot=Snapshot & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|fields:"
For Each f In p.PivotFields
Err.Clear
Snapshot=Snapshot & f.Name & ":" & CStr(f.Orientation) & ":" & CStr(f.Position) & ":" & CStr(f.PivotItems.Count) & ";"
Next
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|cells:"
For Each cell In p.TableRange2.Cells
If Not IsEmpty(cell.Value2) Then Snapshot=Snapshot & cell.Address & "=" & CStr(cell.Value2) & ";"
Next
End Function

Dim p As PivotTable,f As PivotField,cell As Range
Set p=Worksheets(1).PivotTables("Made")
Snapshot="r1:" & p.TableRange1.Address & "|r2:" & p.TableRange2.Address
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|db:"
If p.DataBodyRange Is Nothing Then
Snapshot=Snapshot & "Nothing"
Else
Snapshot=Snapshot & p.DataBodyRange.Address
End If
Snapshot=Snapshot & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Err.Clear
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|rows:"
Snapshot=Snapshot & p.RowRange.Address
Snapshot=Snapshot & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Err.Clear
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|cols:"
Snapshot=Snapshot & p.ColumnRange.Address
Snapshot=Snapshot & ":err" & CStr(Err.Number)
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|fields:"
For Each f In p.PivotFields
Err.Clear
Snapshot=Snapshot & f.Name & ":" & CStr(f.Orientation) & ":" & CStr(f.Position) & ":" & CStr(f.PivotItems.Count) & ";"
Next
Snapshot=Snapshot & "|cells:"
For Each cell In p.TableRange2.Cells
If Not IsEmpty(cell.Value2) Then Snapshot=Snapshot & cell.Address & "=" & CStr(cell.Value2) & ";"
Next
End Function
